risk.rationale: Verified evidence is LIKELY (0.49-0.52), not confirmed, so this is not a confirmed account takeover chain (contain). Suspicious sign-ins from Cloudvault VPS (DE) outside baseline (F1) are not explained away by F2 (DE being the most common sign-in location does not validate a non-baseline VPS ASN), so not benign. The VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 is on CISA KEV with multiple CVEs (F3) - an active exposure - and there is a data-quality conflict (DQ vpn_session_order failing) on that same appliance. Per the escalate criteria (exposure or conflicting/insufficient evidence needing a human), this requires human review rather than automated monitoring.
